title: Mukhtar Zindabad
body:
Mukhtar Zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Lisaratil Hussain..(6)
Mukhtar, Mukhtar, Mukhtar Zindabaad, Mukhtar Zindabaad!
Ai Qasr-e-Inteqaam Ke...
Ai Qasr-e-Inteqaam Ke Me'maar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Parcham Pe Ye Hussain Ke Likha Hai Bakhuda, Badla Khuda Ne Lena Hai Qatle Hussain Ka, Yaani Hai Tu Khuda Ka..
Yaani Hai Tu Khuda Ka Madadgaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haasil Use Bhi Baap Ke Jaisa Kamaal Hai
Taakat Tumhari Maalik-e-Ashtar Ka Laal Hai
Kya Muntakhib Kiya Hai...
Kya Muntakhib Kiya Hai Alamdaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Cheda Nahi Ushe Jo Azadaar Mil Gaya
Chhoda Nahi Jo Sheh Ka Gunahagaar Mil Gaya
Aisa Hi Hona Chahiye...
Aisa Hi Hona Chahiye Kirdaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shimr O Umar, Tufail, Ibn-e-kahil-e-shaqi
Ibn-e-numayr, Ibn-e-anas, Ibn-e-wajibi
Chun Chun Ke Tu Ne Maare...
Chun Chun Ke Tu Ne Maare Gunahagaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ghar Ghar Se Aa Rahi Hai Sada Ya Hussain Ki
Ab Tak Sadaayen Deti Hai Kufe Ki Har Gali
Tu Zindabaad Aur...
Tu Zindabaad Aur Teri Sarkaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Munsif Bhi Khud Hai Khud Hi Tu Apna Wakeel Hai
Maasoom Ki Khushi Tere Haq Mein Daleel Hai
Raazi Hai Tujh Se...
Raazi Hai Tujh Se Aabid-e-beemaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Lamhe Nabi Ke Ghar Mein Kuchh Aaye Hain Chain Ke
Chun Kar Jo Tu Ne Maare Hain Kaatil Hussain Ke
Mismaar Kar Di...
Mismaar Kar Di Zulm Ki Deewaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar Zindabaad..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mukhtar Naama Haq Ki Takallum Hai Daastaan
Khoon Mein Naha Ke Kehti Hai Kufe Ki Surkhiya'n
Chilla Raha Hai Shaam Ka...
Chilla Raha Hai Shaam Ka Akhbaar Zindabaad Zindabaad Zindabaad!
<<MINI>>
Mukhtar, Mukhtar, Mukhtar Zindabaad!
Mukhtar, Mukhtar, Mukhtar Zindabaad!
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Lisaratil Hussain...
author: Mir Hassan Mir
